translations.title: Claude 4.7 launches
translations.excerpt_en:
Anthropic has launched Claude 4.7, its most capable model to date.

The new model demonstrates significant improvements in reasoning, coding, and multilingual tasks.

Benchmark results show Claude 4.7 outperforming competitors across all major evaluation sets.
